description:
Edit one of the user's email templates and show the updated inbox preview. For tweaks pass replacements (exact find → replace in "html", "subject" or "text"); to redesign pass full html. When the HTML changes, the plain-text version is regenerated unless it was hand-written or you pass text_body. Workflows using this template send the new version from their next step.
